relationship: Two endpoints determine distance, midpoint, gradient and a perpendicular bisector whose points are equally distant from both endpoints.

learnerLoop.action: Move the endpoints, boundary and test point, then calculate the linked quantities.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The segment and candidate perpendicular boundary update together.
learnerLoop.evidence: Live equal-distance tests, map labels and checked calculations show whether the boundary is correct.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Adjust the boundary or use the computed midpoint and perpendicular gradient to justify it.

invariants: Every point on the perpendicular bisector is equidistant from the two endpoints.
The midpoint lies on both the segment and its perpendicular bisector.
safeAdaptations: Use different endpoint pairs and valid target boundaries.
Change calculation scaffolding while retaining continuous equal-distance evidence.
nonGoals: Presenting a line as a perpendicular bisector without testing or deriving its equal-distance property.
